raw_html: [[Boon of Undeath|Boon of Undeath]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Boon of Undeath|Boon of Undeath]]:''' Undead take solace in the hate of others. Every time a character wearing a Boon of Undeath item is struck in combat, an [[Inflict Light Wounds]] spell will be cast on the character.
